description: Verify a Lazaretto scan attestation that another agent (or a README, or a lockfile) handed you, WITHOUT re-scanning or paying. Free and anonymous. Returns signature validity and the signed claims, including verdict, risk and subject. For a clear or flagged SHA-256 subject only, checks the current known-bad indicator set and includes `contradicted` when it matches. That field is otherwise omitted; its absence is not a freshness or safety verdict. Package identities are not rechecked here. A valid signature authenticates an earlier claim, not current safety. The artifact's hash or package identity must match `claims.sub` for the claim to apply.

attestation.description: The compact-JWS attestation string from a scan report.

name: verify_attestation

outputSchema.description: A valid signature proves Lazaretto issued the verdict. It does NOT prove the artifact in front of you is the one attested: check claims.sub yourself.

analysis_partial.description: Present and true when part of the artifact went unread. A clear verdict with this set is not a clean result.

sub.description: The subject the verdict is about: a sha256 or a package identity. Confirm this matches what you are about to run.

contradicted.description: Present only when a clear or flagged SHA-256 subject now matches the known-bad indicator set. Omitted for package identities, already-malicious claims, misses and unavailable lookups; omission does not establish freshness or safety.

reason.description: Why an invalid attestation failed, for example malformed_jws.

valid.description: Whether the signature verifies against Lazaretto's published keys.

title: Verify a scan attestation (free)
